children: Shuttle Pharmaceuticals entered into a First Amendment to its Merger Agreement with United Dogecoin, reducing the milestone requirement from 2,000 to 500 mining rigs. No other terms of the merger were changed, and the maximum number of pre-funded warrants tied to the milestone remains unchanged. The company is also seeking similar amendments to related financing and asset purchase documents, subject to counterparty approvals.
: United Dogecoin and Shuttle Merger Sub
: Reduce milestone target to reflect current operating plans
